verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so accounts payable aging and point-in-time vendor balances are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of AP aging reports, vendor balance views, or as-of-date reporting. The contacts API, authentication, and invoicing material cited is adjacent and does not show this capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
